text:
Hi handlers,
Before opening changed little, but handler training stayed in focus. Keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk steady today: check carrier labels, confirm handoff notes, and flag anything that looks off before it reaches the gate team. Safety still beats speed, and a clean handoff saves us all a mess later.

For traveler care, keep the tone warm and brisk. <<FACT F119>> If a case needs follow-up, log the details clearly and keep the updates short. <<FACT F031>> When you see a tight connection or a shaky transfer, say so early and move it up the chain without delay.

One more thing: missed connection reviews should stay factual and calm. <<FACT F110>> We can help people better when the notes are crisp and the chain of care is easy to read. Thanks for staying sharp and keeping Aurelia Skyways dependable.
Companion Animal Travel Desk
